microtheory.name: developmental_biology
microtheory.definition: How organisms develop from zygote to adult. Pattern formation, morphogenesis, organogenesis, regeneration. Hox genes, signaling gradients, evolutionary conservation. Substrate analogue: substrate's structural unfolding from seed to mature state.

concepts.name: embryogenesis
concepts.definition: Earliest development. Cleavage, gastrulation, neurulation. Body axes established. Substrate analogue: substrate's earliest Mt formation.

concepts.name: gastrulation
concepts.definition: Lewis Wolpert: most important time in your life. Embryo reorganizes into three germ layers. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational reorganization.

concepts.name: germ_layer
concepts.definition: Ectoderm (skin, nervous), mesoderm (muscle, bone, blood), endoderm (gut, lungs). Substrate analogue: substrate's three foundational Mt-types.

concepts.name: organogenesis
concepts.definition: Organs form from germ layers. Heart, brain, gut, limbs. Substrate analogue: substrate's specialized Mt emergence.

concepts.name: morphogen
concepts.definition: Diffusible signaling molecule creating gradients that pattern tissues. French flag model. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-gradient.

concepts.name: positional_information
concepts.definition: Wolpert. Cells know position from morphogen gradients + respond accordingly. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-position Mt response.

concepts.name: turing_pattern
concepts.definition: Turing 1952. Reaction-diffusion producing spatial patterns. Spots, stripes. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-organizing patterns.

concepts.name: lateral_inhibition_development
concepts.definition: Cell becoming X inhibits neighbors from becoming X. Salt-and-pepper patterns. Substrate analogue: substrate's argmax-via-inhibition for Mt-types.

concepts.name: hox_genes_development
concepts.definition: Master regulators specifying body plan along anterior-posterior axis. Conserved across animals. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational positional commitments.

concepts.name: homeotic_mutation
concepts.definition: Body part replaced by another (legs for antennae). Reveals Hox function. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-replacement under regulatory failure.

concepts.name: master_regulator
concepts.definition: Transcription factor initiating differentiation program. Pax6 → eye, MyoD → muscle. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-initiating Concept.

concepts.name: cell_fate_determination
concepts.definition: Cell committed to specific lineage. Initially flexible, becoming progressively restricted. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt commitment trajectory.

concepts.name: cell_potency_development
concepts.definition: Range of types cell can become. Totipotent → pluripotent → multipotent → unipotent → terminal. Substrate analogue: substrate's potential-Mt range.

concepts.name: induction
concepts.definition: One tissue inducing differentiation in another via signals. Spemann's organizer. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-induced Mt formation.

concepts.name: developmental_constraint
concepts.definition: Limits on what can evolve due to developmental architecture. Substrate analogue: substrate's path-dependent evolution.

concepts.name: phenotypic_plasticity
concepts.definition: Same genotype producing different phenotypes in different environments. Substrate analogue: substrate's environment-responsive expression.

concepts.name: canalization
concepts.definition: Waddington. Developmental trajectories buffered against perturbation. Different paths converge. Substrate analogue: substrate's robust developmental basins.

concepts.name: epigenetic_landscape
concepts.definition: Waddington. Ball rolling down landscape representing developmental decisions. Substrate analogue: substrate's developmental basin landscape.

concepts.name: regeneration
concepts.definition: Restoring lost body parts. Salamanders, hydra. Lost in mammals. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-restoration capability.

concepts.name: stem_cell_development
concepts.definition: Source of new cells throughout life. Tissue-specific niches. Substrate analogue: substrate's generative-Mt reservoir.

concepts.name: evo_devo_conservation
concepts.definition: Same developmental machinery across distant species. Eye development by Pax6 in fly + mouse. Substrate analogue: substrate's universal developmental kernel.

concepts.name: deep_homology
concepts.definition: Shanks. Apparent independent evolution actually using shared deep machinery. Substrate analogue: substrate's hidden shared foundations.

concepts.name: heterochrony
concepts.definition: Change in developmental timing producing evolutionary change. Neoteny: humans as juvenile chimps. Substrate analogue: substrate's developmental-timing variation.

concepts.name: stem_cell_niche
concepts.definition: Microenvironment maintaining stem cells. Substrate analogue: substrate's preserved-generativity region.

concepts.name: tissue_engineering
concepts.definition: Building tissues from cells + scaffolds. Regenerative medicine. Substrate analogue: substrate's reconstruction methodology.

rules.name: morphogen_gradients_pattern_tissues
rules.head: the substrate forms structure during development
rules.body: diffusible signals create gradients; cells read position + respond. Wolpert. Substrate's per-position differentiation.

rules.name: hox_genes_specify_body_plan
rules.head: the substrate establishes major axes
rules.body: conserved master regulators specify what forms where along axes. Substrate's foundational positional commitments.

rules.name: induction_propagates_differentiation
rules.head: the substrate has differentiating cells adjacent to undifferentiated
rules.body: the differentiating cells signal neighbors to differentiate. Cascading commitment. Substrate's Mt-induced Mt formation.

rules.name: canalization_buffers_development
rules.head: the substrate develops along a trajectory
rules.body: the trajectory is robust to perturbation — different starting conditions converge. Waddington. Substrate's resilient development.

rules.name: deep_homology_explains_unexpected_similarity
rules.head: the substrate has two structures that appear independently evolved
rules.body: examination reveals shared deep developmental machinery. Substrate's hidden shared foundations.
